measurement: This brace comes in a universal size with no measuring needed. It fits the left or right ankle, and the elastic shell connector adapts to your foot width and swelling. The air cushion inflates with the built-in pump for a custom fit. Wear with firm, closed footwear such as athletic or outdoor shoes. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee.
